infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Jono needs microphone access for voice recording. All audio is processed locally on your device.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Jono uses Apple's on-device speech recognition to transcribe your recordings. Your voice data is processed locally and never leaves your device.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Jono may access your photo library when you choose to attach images to your entries.

plugins.microphonePermission: Jono needs microphone access to record your voice notes and conversations. All recordings stay on your device and are never uploaded without your permission.
